title.narrative: Emergency Initiative in favor of the population affected by the humanitarian and economic crisis in Mali and Senegal
Iniziativa di Emergenza in favore delle popolazioni colpite dalla crisi umanitaria ed economica in Mali e Senegal

description.narrative: L’iniziativa intende far fronte all’emergenza umanitaria in atto nelle regioni centro-settentrionali del Mali, attraverso attività di sicurezza e assistenza alimentare, nonché di lotta alla malnutrizione, volte a rafforzare la capacità di sopravvivenza e sussistenza delle categorie più vulnerabili colpite dal conflitto in atto. L’iniziativa intende inoltre promuovere la capacità di generare redditi e sostenere il settore privato nel Senegal e nelle regioni centro-meridionali del Mali, colpite dagli effetti della pandemia COVID-19.

The initiative aims to promote actions aimed at addressing the humanitarian emergency in the central and northern regions of Mali, through activities of food security, food assistance, and fight against malnutrition, aimed at strengthening the survival and subsistence capacity of most vulnerable categories affected by the ongoing conflict. The initiative will also promote the ability of generating income and to support the private sector in Senegal and in the central and southern regions of Mali, affected by the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.

tag.narrative: Adopt policies, especially fiscal, wage and social protection policies, and progressively achieve greater equality

By 2030, achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all women and men, including for young people and persons with disabilities, and equal pay for work of equal value

By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
Reduce inequality within and among countries
